subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which session activity contract and Control UI scope should own the compact active-run progress surface requested here?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested activity model, while related open issues and PRs propose competing gateway, status-row, and UI scopes for a stable protocol surface.

options.title: Approve canonical activity contract first
options.body: Settle the #39127-style activity, attention, reconnect, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics before implementing the compact Control UI strip.

options.title: Adopt and narrow an open PR
options.body: Choose #96672 or #92697 as the landing path after trimming scope, resolving merge conflicts, and proving upgrade-safe behavior.

options.title: Defer the UI strip
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until maintainers are ready to expand the gateway/session activity contract.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical activity contract first
recommendation.body: Settle the #39127-style activity, attention, reconnect, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics before implementing the compact Control UI strip.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the Control UI and gateway session surfaces that would need to agree on the user-facing behavior.
